id: title:charlesvien:publish agent to npm from a github hosted runner

review.posthog_relevance: Supports release of PostHog desktop agent or npm package, but no PostHog-specific implementation is shown.
review.reason: This chunk is a GitHub Actions workflow change. The hunk P1.F1.H1 changes the runner environment from a self-hosted depot-ubuntu-24.04-4 to a GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest, with a comment explaining npm provenance compatibility. No PostHog-specific code, configuration, or dependency is shown. The connection to PostHog is indirect: this could support the release of PostHog's desktop/.
review.uncertainty: This score is assigned because the change is a localized maintenance update to CI infrastructure. While it could support PostHog releases, the lack of PostHog-specific implementation, configuration, or dependency makes the benefit indirect and unverified. No tier 2 or 3 systemic improvements are demonstrated.
